surface: release tooling, status surfaces, and release ceremony templates
summary: Updates release guidance to hard-reset legacy release to main after shipping and adds explicit release branch mode/state fields in status outputs.
migration_impact: Repositories using legacy release should update release runbooks/checklists to reset release to main (not to a version tag) and can now consume branch mode/warnings from release status JSON.
migration_guidance: 1. Replace legacy post-release commands that reset release to vX.Y.Z with: git checkout release && git fetch origin && git reset --hard origin/main && git push --force-with-lease.
2. If automation parses gh plate release status JSON, read the new fields: release_track_branches, release_branch_mode, release_branch_reset_target, and warnings.
3. If status reports legacy/hybrid/none warnings, run gh plate bootstrap --apply to repair standing release branch state.
agent_notes: Use release_branch_mode and warnings to detect legacy fallback and branch drift before opening integration PRs.
